policy: Five distinct previously uncached hosts from the same solar-radius opportunity pool with confirmed transiting planets of0.5..3Earth radii and0.5..20day periods. Rank planet depth proxies by absolute distance from200ppm, then TIC/name; same adjacency/contamination requirements. Positive controls excluded from unknown-object pool. Pass only if target planet has a top-three period within1% AND no original screening flags. Other known planets and harmonics reported separately; no threshold changes. No held-out data is opened. Nonrandom controls, not completeness.
